firm_data.firm_description: Anderson Bowman PLLC provides legal guidance for individuals, property owners, investors, and businesses facing complex legal and financial matters. With a strong concentration in real estate law, bankruptcy, and commercial litigation, the firm supports clients through high-stakes situations where legal decisions directly impact long-term financial and business outcomes.
notable_facts: Providing Expert Legal Services Across Queens & the New York Metro Area Since 2012
Decades of Dedicated Representation in Queens & Throughout New York

email.subject: AI for Anderson Bowman PLLC, built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Dustin,

With your focus on real estate transactions, partitions, and litigation across Queens and the New York Metro Area, you're navigating some of the most document-intensive practice areas in law. Since 2012, Anderson Bowman has built that expertise, but competing on efficiency against larger firms requires the right tools.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms that face BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of smaller practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now expanding regionally to meet firms like yours. I'd be happy to stop by and share how our ex-lawyer team is helping similar firms compete with BigLaw.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
